_readme: English source catalog. Edit the text here; run `npm run translate` to refresh the other nine languages. Every entry needs a short note for translators. {name} style placeholders must be kept exactly. Plural keys end in .one/.other (and .zero where used).

translate.working.note: Small status shown at the bottom of the screen while the rest of the page is being translated. Keep it very short.

translate.unavailable.text: Translation is temporarily unavailable. The page stays in English.
translate.unavailable.note: Shown when the automatic translation service cannot be reached.

translate.dismiss.note: Screen-reader name of the button that closes the translation notice.

footer.nav.aria.note: Screen-reader name of the footer navigation.

footer.name.note: Name of the kingdom in the footer. Keep Kingdom 710 as is.

footer.tag.note: Short slogan under the kingdom name. KvK stays KvK.

footer.group.members.note: Footer column heading for pages that need a member sign-in.

footer.link.home.note: Footer link to the home page.

footer.link.apply.note: Footer link to the application page for people who want to join.

footer.link.help.note: Footer link to the help page.

footer.link.about.note: Footer link to the About page.

footer.link.timeline.note: Footer link to the game release timeline.

footer.link.gallery.note: Footer link to the picture gallery.

footer.link.glossary.note: Footer link to the glossary of game words.

footer.link.dashboard.note: Footer link to the member dashboard.

footer.link.power.note: Footer link to the power profile form.

footer.link.forms.note: Footer link to the member forms.

footer.link.tools.note: Footer link to the calculators and tools.

footer.link.events.note: Footer link to the events page.

footer.donate.note: Text of the donation link. Keep K710 Hub.

footer.donate.aria.text: Support K710 Hub (opens Ko-fi donation page in a new tab)
footer.donate.aria.note: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the donation link.

form.closed.title.note: Heading of the notice shown instead of a closed form.

form.closed.default.text: An admin has closed this form for now. Check back later.
form.closed.default.note: Default explanation under the closed-form heading.

form.errors.one.note: Heading of the error summary above a form when exactly one field has a problem.

form.errors.other.note: Heading of the error summary when several fields have problems. {count} is a number.

lang.button.label.note: Short label for the language picker button and dialog.

lang.button.aria.note: Screen-reader name of the language button. {language} is the current language's own name, for example Español.

lang.picker.title.note: Heading of the language picker dialog.

lang.picker.close.note: Button that closes the language picker without changing anything.

lang.picker.selected.note: Screen-reader text for the check mark on the language that is in use.

lang.picker.hint.text: Tap a language to switch. The whole page changes at once.
lang.picker.hint.note: One short line under the picker heading.

chrome.skip.note: Keyboard link at the very top of every page that jumps past the menu.

chrome.menu.note: Button that opens the navigation menu on a phone.

chrome.menu.open.note: Screen-reader name of the menu button when the menu is closed.

chrome.menu.close.note: Screen-reader name of the menu button when the menu is open.

chrome.nav.home.note: Navigation link to the home page.

chrome.nav.about.note: Navigation menu title for the About section.

chrome.nav.aboutKingdom.note: Navigation link. Kingdom 710 is the name of the game kingdom; keep 710.

chrome.nav.timeline.note: Navigation link to the page that lists when game features were released.

chrome.nav.gallery.note: Navigation link to the photo and screenshot gallery.

chrome.nav.glossary.note: Navigation link to the page that explains game words.

chrome.nav.guides.note: Navigation link to the how-to guides.

chrome.nav.help.note: Navigation link to the help page.

chrome.nav.members.note: Navigation menu title for pages only for kingdom members.

chrome.nav.dashboard.note: Navigation link to the member's home page with their forms.

chrome.nav.forms.note: Navigation link to the list of forms members fill in.

chrome.nav.tools.note: Navigation link to the calculators and planning tools.

chrome.nav.events.note: Navigation link to the event schedules.

chrome.nav.apply.note: Button for players who want to join the kingdom.

chrome.nav.powerProfile.note: Navigation link. Power Profile is a form name; keep it in English.

chrome.nav.myForms.note: Small heading in the Members menu above the list of the member's forms.

chrome.nav.donate.note: Link to the page where people can support the website with a donation.

chrome.nav.mobileLabel.note: Screen-reader name of the phone navigation.

shared.logout.note: Button that ends the member's session.

shared.loggingOut.note: Shown on the log out button while it is working.

shared.open.note: Generic button that opens a page.

shared.close.note: Generic button that closes a panel.

shared.back.note: Generic button that goes back one step.

shared.save.note: Generic button that saves what the member typed.

shared.cancel.note: Generic button that stops without saving.

shared.dash.note: Shown instead of a number when the value is not known. Keep as is.

formStatus.todo.note: Status chip: the member has not filled in this form yet. Shown with an icon and in red.

formStatus.done.note: Status chip: the member has filled in this form. Shown with a check mark and in green.

formStatus.carry.note: Status chip: answers from the last event are filled in; the member should check them and save.

formStatus.closed.note: Status chip: the form is not accepting answers.

formStatus.soon.note: Status chip: the form is not open yet.

formButton.fill.note: Big button that opens a form the member has not done. Short imperative.

formButton.change.note: Quieter button that opens a form the member already saved, so they can edit it.

formButton.check.note: Button that opens a form whose answers were carried over from last time.

formButton.closed.note: Disabled button text for a form that cannot be opened.

formButton.aria.note: Screen-reader name of a form button. {action} is the button text, {form} the form title.

formButton.numberAria.note: Screen-reader name of the number badge on a form card.

form.date.before.note: Deadline line on a form card. {date} is a date and time in the member's own time zone, already formatted.

form.date.opens.note: Line on a form card that is not open yet. {date} is already formatted.

form.date.none.note: Shown on a form card when leadership has not given a closing time.

form.saved.note: Shown on a form card the member already saved. {date} is a short date such as 8 Oct.

form.prep.title.note: Form name. KvK = Kingdom vs Kingdom battle; keep KvK. Keep the name in English or translate only 'Prep' and 'Appointments' if natural.

form.prep.help.text: Chief Minister buffs · before prep days
form.prep.help.note: One line under the form name. Chief Minister is a game role name; keep it in English. 'Prep days' are the preparation days before a KvK.

form.noble.title.note: Form name. Noble Advisor is a game role; keep in English.

form.noble.help.note: One line under the form name. Members pick a time slot when their troops train with the Noble Advisor.

form.dragon.title.note: Form and event name; keep in English.

form.dragon.help.text: Your troops and heroes for the event
form.dragon.help.note: One line under the form name. 'Heroes' are the in-game hero characters.

form.joiner.title.note: Form name. KvK = Kingdom vs Kingdom battle; keep KvK.

form.joiner.help.text: When you can play · troops and heroes
form.joiner.help.note: One line under the form name. Members say which battle hours they can be online.

dash.pageTitle.note: Browser tab and screen-reader name of the member home page.

dash.greeting.note: Big greeting at the top of the member page. {name} is the player's in-game name.

dash.left.one.text: You have {count} form left to do.
dash.left.one.note: Sentence under the greeting. {count} is shown in a bright colour. Singular: exactly one form left.

dash.left.other.text: You have {count} forms left to do.
dash.left.other.note: Plural of the sentence above, for any number other than one.

dash.allDone.note: Calm message when every open form is done.

dash.allDoneHint.text: You can still change your answers any time while a form is open.

dash.nothingOpen.text: Nothing to fill in right now. Check back when leadership opens a form.
dash.nothingOpen.note: Shown when no form is open. 'Leadership' means the kingdom's officers.

dash.myForms.note: Heading of the forms card on the member dashboard.

dash.todoCount.note: Small count after the My forms heading, for example 2 to do. {count} is a number.

dash.formsHeading.note: Heading above the numbered list of form cards.

dash.alsoOpen.note: Heading above short rows for extra forms (event votes) that are open.

dash.loading.note: Shown while the list of forms loads.

dash.loadError.text: We could not load your forms just now. Try again in a moment.
dash.loadError.note: Error shown when the form list cannot be loaded.

dash.loadErrorLink.note: Link next to the load error that goes to the full forms list.

dash.result.label.note: Small label on a row that shows a decision made by leadership (for example an appointment time), not a form to fill in.

dash.result.new.note: Highlight on a result row when leadership has just published the member's appointment.

dash.result.see.note: Button on a result row when the member's appointment time is ready.

dash.power.title.note: Row title. Power Profile is a form name; keep it in English. Optional = not required.

dash.power.help.note: Short hint on the Power Profile row. Charms and Governor Gear are game items; the scanner reads game screenshots.

dash.power.todo.note: Small status on the Power Profile row when the member has not filled it in.

dash.more.title.note: Title of the collapsed section at the bottom of the member page.

dash.more.hint.note: Short hint on the collapsed More section listing what is inside.

dash.more.allForms.note: Link to the page that lists every form.

dash.more.events.note: Link to the event calendar and schedules.

dash.more.tools.note: Link to calculators that help plan upgrades.

dash.more.giftCodes.note: Heading for the section with in-game gift codes.

dash.more.deadlines.note: Heading for the list of upcoming events and form deadlines.

dash.more.noDeadlines.text: No dated events or deadlines are scheduled yet.
dash.more.noDeadlines.note: Shown when the deadline list is empty.

dash.more.dueSoon.note: Small tag on a deadline that is less than two days away.

dash.more.estimated.note: Warning on a deadline whose date is a guess.

dash.account.title.note: Heading for the player's account details.

dash.account.connected.note: Shows the player is signed in with their game account.

dash.account.kingdom.note: {id} is the kingdom number, for example 710.

dash.account.noAlliance.note: Shown when the player has no alliance.

dash.account.power.note: Label for the player's total strength number in the game.

dash.account.mysticTrial.note: Game feature name; keep in English. Label for the player's best Mystic Trial result.

dash.account.session.text: Signed in with Kingshot. Your session stays active for 30 days unless you log out.
dash.account.session.note: Kingshot is the name of the game; keep it. Explains how long the login lasts.

dash.account.noAdmin.text: Your member account does not have administrator access.
dash.account.noAdmin.note: Shown when a member tried to open the admin area without permission.

dash.footer.text: Times are shown in your own time zone.
dash.footer.note: Footer note on the member page.

dash.wordmarkAria.note: Screen-reader name of the logo link at the top left. Keep K710.

dash.mainAria.note: Screen-reader name of the main page area.

dash.sideAria.note: Screen-reader name of the side column on desktop.

dash.moreNavAria.note: Screen-reader name of the list of links inside the More section.

easy.label.note: Button that switches to larger text and bigger buttons.

easy.aria.text: Easy view: larger text and buttons
easy.aria.note: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the Easy view button.

alliances.discord.link.note: Small button next to a leader's name that opens their Discord profile. Keep Discord as is.

alliances.discord.aria.note: Screen-reader name of the Discord button. {name} is a person's name and must stay exactly as written. Keep Discord as is.

alliances.bearHunts.note: Small label above an alliance's daily Bear Hunt times. Bear Hunt is a game event and keeps its English name.

alliances.view.note: Link at the bottom of an alliance box. {tag} is the alliance short name such as RED and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.status.open.note: Status label of an alliance that is accepting new members.

alliances.status.selective.note: Status label of an alliance that only accepts some applicants.

alliances.status.closed.note: Status label of an alliance that is not accepting new members.

alliances.leadership.none.text: Leadership will be listed here soon.
alliances.leadership.none.note: Calm line shown in the Leadership panel when no leaders have been added yet.

alliances.leadership.contact.note: Small role label above a leadership contact given only as free text.

alliances.strip.status.note: Small caps label of the recruiting status cell at the top of an alliance page.

alliances.strip.members.note: Small caps label above the number of members of an alliance.

alliances.strip.language.note: Small caps label above the main language of an alliance.

alliances.strip.timezone.note: Small caps label above the timezone focus of an alliance.

alliances.eyebrow.note: Small line above the alliance name in the page banner. Kingdom 710 stays as is. {tag} is the alliance short name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.back.note: Link back to the list of all alliances. Keep the arrow.

alliances.panel.leadership.note: Heading of the panel that lists the alliance leaders (R5, R4, Transfer Manager).

alliances.panel.bear.note: Heading of the panel with the alliance's daily Bear Hunt times. Bear Hunt keeps its English name.

alliances.panel.join.note: Heading of the panel that invites visitors to apply to the alliance.

alliances.bear.calendar.text: Add {tag} Bear Hunts to my calendar
alliances.bear.calendar.note: Link that downloads a calendar file with the alliance's Bear Hunt times. {tag} is the alliance short name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.bear.all.text: See all alliance Bear Hunt times →
alliances.bear.all.note: Link to the page listing every alliance. Keep the arrow.

alliances.join.line.text: Ready to move? Send a transfer application and our officers will help you join {name}.
alliances.join.line.note: Short invitation in the Join panel. {name} is the alliance name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.join.cta.note: Button that opens the transfer application. {name} is the alliance name and must stay exactly as written.
